design_philosophy.vibe: Precision meets Nature. High-density data presented with organic calm.
principles: Fusion: Industrial reliability (Swiss Style) + Organic warmth (Forest tones)
Density: Maximize data visibility without clutter. Use 'Twinlist' patterns for validation.
Clarity: Divergences must scream (Orange/Red), Matches must whisper (Green/Grey).

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, KPI values

mono.usage: Log IDs, Data cells, Numerical values in tables

primary.description: Deep Forest Green - Main Brand Color, Sidebars, Primary Buttons

layout_strategy.container_style: Card-based with 1px border, no shadow (Flat Technical Look)

components.charts: Recharts (Styled with custom tooltip and minimal axes)

special_components.name: TwinlistValidator
special_components.description: Side-by-side comparison view for SGF vs WoodTech logs. Highlight diffs in Orange.

special_components.name: KPICard
special_components.description: Bento-style card with icon, big metric, and sparkline.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on solid backgrounds to reduce digital sterility.
visual_enhancers.gradients: None. Use solid blocks of color.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None or extremely subtle 'sm' for dropdowns only.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border everywhere. 'Grid Borders' style for dashboards.

auth_background.description: Truck carrying large bamboo stalks/logs. Use with heavy #1A3C34 overlay (90% opacity) on Auth screens.

hero_texture.description: Stack of cut logs. Use for 'Empty State' or '404' pages.

user_avatar.description: Professional industrial worker. Placeholder for user profile.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Manrope'.
Primary buttons should be Forest Green (#1A3C34). Destructive/Alert buttons should be Orange (#F97316).
instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'Manrope' and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts in index.css.
Update tailwind.config.js with the custom colors (Forest Green, Safety Orange).
Create the Auth page with the split-screen layout (Image on right).
Build the Dashboard using a Bento Grid layout.
Implement the 'Twinlist' comparison view for the Validation page.
